If you run the Octopus Live relay on a home server, the app reads from it instead of Octopus, so refreshes can be as often as every 10 seconds. Away from home it falls back to Octopus using your API key.
Notifications are off for this app — enable them in Settings to see live usage.
Ongoing notification with live electricity demand

Updates pause while the screen is off and resume when you unlock. Your API key is stored only on this phone and is sent only to Octopus Energy. Octopus limits how often its API can be called, so keep the interval at 60 seconds or more, especially if the PC widget is also running.
